title: Methodology-Level Audit Gap: Named Deferrals (FF1 + FF3)
summary: FF1 (practitioner-originated framing absorption is not audited by any specialist subagent) and FF3 (in-place amendments to RESEARCH artifacts during downstream phases have no re-audit protocol) are recorded as recognized gaps at vocabulary level; structural amendment is deferred with two-direction graduation triggers (harm evidence or reliance evidence over 2–4 cycles). The R5 post-gate narrow re-audit pattern is named as the current compound defense.
mechanism: named deferral with two-direction graduation trigger

links.note: the graduation-trigger element applied to a deferral rather than a mechanism; two-direction trigger closes the asymmetry a harm-only trigger would create
applies ADR-097's filter reflexively to its own scope choice; extends the Three-Application F-P2 Pattern count to six
ADR-100's two-direction graduation trigger (reliance and harm) follows this ADR's form
